scope: TRF-035 two frozen reviewer arms only; no additional requirements

classes.TRANSPORT_INFRASTRUCTURE: HTTP/network/service failures; preserve provider HTTP/raw failure artifacts; terminal.
classes.PIPELINE_INTEGRITY_ROUTING_OR_MISSING_IO: Hash/binding/identity/routing errors or missing final provider output; terminal; preserve rejected packet and error.
classes.REVIEWER_RESPONSE_PROTOCOL_FAILURE: Malformed/incomplete/inconsistent reviewer response; one shared correction per arm then recorded bounded failure; continue next arm if no infrastructure/integrity failure.
classes.SUBSTANTIVE_LLM_INTERPRETATION_OR_CODE_E: Only establish by independent post-closure source/code inspection. A valid response alone is not correctness evidence; invalid output may still contain substantive claims.
classes.GENUINE_SOURCE_SCHEMA_AMBIGUITY: Requires independent confirmation that approved source/representation leaves material uncertainty; model questions alone are reported uncertainty.
classes.EVALUATION_ATTRIBUTION_UNCERTAINTY: Keep existing evaluation and its attribution limits separate; no new evaluation, workflow credit or candidate selection in reviewer-only comparison.

frozen_stops: At most two primary reviews, one per arm; at most one shared correction per arm; four provider calls total.
Zero generation, repair, additional retrieval or edited candidate.
600-second dispatch window, 180-second per-request timeout, 16000 output tokens per call, 64000 reserved output tokens.
No fallback, criteria change, rerun or live changes. Existing output ID refuses repeat execution.
Ordinary bounded reviewer failures continue to next arm; infrastructure/integrity failure stops and records pending arm NOT_RUN.
analysis_policy: Review all arms after dispatch closure, preserve raw evidence for every classification. Compare recurring patterns with already saved cross-requirement evidence only; this launch does not expand the sample.
